candidats.titre: File:'Haunted window' of The Black Horse Inn, Nuthurst, West Sussex 1.jpg
candidats.description: Upstairs window of the Black Horse Inn public house , one of Sussex's most haunted pubs, on Nuthurst Street in Nuthurst , West Sussex , England. In this window at the front of the building is often seen the ghostly face of a young woman who is believed met an untimely death, locals knowledge stating she was one of the pub's serving maids or female occupants of the cottages before they were converted as part of today's inn. The Black Horse is also haunted by a local murderer who drank here and moves items across a table: see 'Haunted table' of The Black Horse Inn ; by the ghost of 'Nuthurst Ned
